name_note: GTDB's s__Avelusimicrobium fimicola covers genomes named Candidatus Avelusimicrobium fimicolum in NCBI; the retrieved literature names the genus Avelusimicrobium but not this species.

sentences.text: Avelusimicrobium is a bacterial genus in the family Elusimicrobiaceae, phylum Elusimicrobiota, proposed from high-quality genomes of uncultured representatives under the rules of SeqCode.
The phylum Elusimicrobiota has been described as containing only two described species, with a biology that has been only poorly explored.
Isolates of the same family, obtained from the intestinal tracts of cockroaches, were characterised as small, pleomorphic gram-negative rods and obligately anaerobic fermenters.
A report on the gut microbiome of the naked mole-rat describes Avelusimicrobium within Elusimicrobiota among metagenome-assembled genomes recovered from that rodent.
